children: Over the last few days, momentum across the broad crypto market has turned extremely bearish and Solana has also had its share of the downturn.

Amid the sudden market volatility, Solana and other major crypto assets have continued to record notable sell-off activity. Whale Alert has showcased data for one of such transactions, which may have just been a massive whale sellout.
According to the data, an unknown address has moved a total of 470,087 SOL worth over $51 million at Solana's current price to leading U.S. crypto exchange Coinbase.
The large Solana transaction, which happened in a single transfer, did not go unnoticed, especially considering its timing, drawing attention from market analysts.

Although the intention behind the transfer was not stated, market participants perceive the move as an attempt to sell, as tokens are often transferred to trading platforms like Coinbase for selling purposes.
The timing of the transfer also stirred speculation that the trader may be exiting the market out of caution amid the ongoing market volatility.

Despite surging to a high of around $123 earlier this month, momentum in the Solana ecosystem has weakened significantly after its price suddenly saw a sharp downturn, causing it to fall as low as $105 about two days ago.
has continued to trade below the $110 mark, as the sudden price reversal has stirred fear among traders who have continued to exit their positions.
While the market has continued to see large and small amounts of Solana returned to exchanges, Solana's chances of reclaiming its recent highs keep getting slimmer.

title: Over $51 Million in Solana Returned to Coinbase: Who's Selling?
